d.why: On screen in The Punisher S2 episodes 5-8 as a member of Billy Russo's crew (mentioned only in episode 9).
On screen in The Punisher S2 episodes 5 and 6 (One-Eyed Jacks, Nakazat) in Curtis's veterans group, mentioned in episode 7.

On screen only in The Punisher S2 episode 5 (One-Eyed Jacks), where as the episode's antagonist he holds Turk to ambush Frank and is beaten in his gym into naming Poloznev; he is also the Russian Mafia leader over Sergei Konchevsky, who has a file.
On screen in The Punisher S2 episodes 2 and 3 (Fight or Flight, Trouble the Water) as the Larkville deputy.
On screen in The Punisher S2 episodes 3 (flashback), 5 and 13; elsewhere only in photos.
On screen in The Punisher S2 episodes 1-3 leading the mercenaries hunting Amy until John Pilgrim kills her.
Only in The Punisher S2 episode 7 (One Bad Day), a Jigsaw crew gunman who zip-ties the ReadyQuick staff and is shot by Frank, a helper in Billy's heist with no family or boss tie to a filed person.
Only in The Punisher S2 episode 9 (Flustercluck), a Jigsaw crew member who harasses Lanie and is shot by Frank, who uses his phone; a minor crewman with no family or boss tie.

On screen only in The Punisher S2 episode 6 (Nakazat), where he is the target Frank and Amy hunt down and kidnap to learn who wants the photos; he is also the employer of Kazan and Sergei Konchevsky, who have files.
On screen in The Punisher S2 episodes 7-10 as a member of Billy Russo's crew.
On screen in The Punisher S2 episodes 3 and 10 (flashbacks), 5 and 11 (vision) as John Pilgrim's wife.

Only in The Punisher S2 episode 1 (Roadhouse Blues), the Lola's bouncer who throws out a drunk and dies fighting the mercenaries beside Frank, a helper with no family or boss tie (Beth Quinn is only a co-worker).
On screen in The Punisher S2 episodes 2 and 3 (Fight or Flight, Trouble the Water) as the Larkville sheriff.

Only on screen in The Punisher S2 episode 1 (Roadhouse Blues), tied up by Pilgrim, taking Amy's call and being strangled, a side figure in Frank and Amy's story; Kazan is only his uncle and Poloznev his employer, not the other way round.

Only on screen in The Punisher S2 episode 9 (Flustercluck), Amy's old crewmate who takes her cash and tips off bounty hunters, a side betrayal in an episode about Frank hunting Billy's crew, with no family or boss tie.
On screen in VisionQuest episode 6 and in flashbacks in episode 7; only a photo, mention or footage elsewhere.
Only in WandaVision episode 7 (Breaking the Fourth Wall), the Air Force engineer who builds Monica's rover and watches it explode, a helper with no family or command tie to a filed person.
Only on screen in WandaVision episode 3 (Now in Color), the Westview doctor who confirms Wanda's pregnancy and delivers Billy, a doctor in someone else's story; his wife has no file.
On screen in Wonder Man episodes Found Footage and Yucca Valley as Jayden's estranged Chamoy Dudes partner.
On screen in Wonder Man episodes 3, 4, 5 and 8 as the Damage Control official.
On screen in Wonder Man episodes Found Footage and Yucca Valley (mentioned in Callback), blackmailing Simon.
On screen in flashbacks in Wonder Man episodes 1, 7 and 8 as Simon's father.
On screen in Wonder Man episodes Matinee and Kathy Friedman as Simon's ex (footage only in Self-Tape).
